name: cavemio-expanding-gallery
title: Expanding gallery
description: An image opens from its exact place in the grid, becomes a spacious viewer, and finds its way back.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The viewer is a top-layer popover with role="dialog" and aria-modal: it opens above everything without making the page inert, which on a large page restyles every element in the frame it opens. Focus is trapped inside, the page behind does not scroll, Escape closes and focus returns to the current thumbnail, including after browsing.
- Left and Right browse, Home and End jump to the first and last image. Buttons expose disabled states at the ends.
- Pointer cancellation restores the image. Horizontal swipes leave vertical touch movement to the browser.
- Reduced motion removes expansion, sliding, overshoot and thumbnail zoom. Navigation and all controls remain available.
- Image IDs must be unique; width and height should match the source asset. The component handles an empty collection.
- The entry point, viewer and motion helpers install together. No global animation stylesheet or animation library is required.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: It opens from its thumbnail
features.description: The image grows from its exact place in the grid into the viewer, keeping its proportions. The caption follows a moment later.

features.title: It returns where it came from
features.description: Closing sends the current image back to its own thumbnail, or fades it if the thumbnail has scrolled out of view.

features.title: Browse by arrow, key or swipe
features.description: The next image arrives from the direction you moved. A swipe follows your finger and the ends resist.

features.title: Focus is handled
features.description: Focus stays inside the viewer, the page behind does not scroll, and Escape closes it and returns focus to the thumbnail.

features.title: Failed images are handled
features.description: A broken image shows a labelled fallback without changing the gallery’s size.

features.title: Real proportions
features.description: Each image has its own width and height, so wide and tall pictures sit in the grid without being cropped in the viewer.

states.title: open
states.description: The viewer measures the thumbnail and destination, then expands the image over 560ms. The caption follows after 180ms.

states.title: browse
states.description: Previous and next images enter from the direction of travel in 380ms. Navigation stops at the ends.

states.title: swipe
states.description: The image follows horizontal dragging. A 64px drag or a deliberate quick flick advances; a short drag settles back. The ends resist movement.

states.title: close
states.description: The current image returns to its measured thumbnail in 380ms. If its thumbnail has left the viewport, it fades away instead.

states.title: unavailable
states.description: A failed image shows a labelled fallback without changing the gallery’s dimensions.
